Text: "Iron, hexahydrite, IIAB Coahuila, Mexico Found 1837 This specimen is part of a meteor shower that long ago dropped over 2,000 kilograms (4,400 lbs) of meteorite fragments in the area around Coahuila, Mexico. Scientists studying the chemistry and structure of Coahuila meteorites, verify that they were once part of a single, larger body.
